§6Combinator Funnel§f §aNo power, no problem. Combines 9 small powders into 1 full powder without touching a single watt.§f §bThe Combinator Funnel§f is a cheap, unpowered substitute for the Automatic Crafting Table. It only works for §e2×2§f or §e3×3§f recipes using the same item, like 9 small powders into 1 full-size powder. §6Usage§f:
§b• Toggle button§f in UI selects 2×2, 3×3, or both patterns
§b• Input slot§f on top
§b• Output slot§f on bottom
§b• No power§f required, completely passive §6Common Uses§f:
§b• §ePowder Compacting§f, 9 small powders → 1 full powder
§b• §eMaterial Condensing§f, nuggets → ingots, ingots → blocks §ePS:§f Pair it with hoppers for a fully passive processing line. Great for early automation before you've got power infrastructure sorted.
